segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // swift-tools-version:5.5 import PackageDescription let package = Package( name: "MyRenderer", products: [ .library( name: "MyRenderer", targets: ["MyRenderer"]), ], targets: [ // MyRenderer contains .swift and .metal files. .target( name: "MyRenderer", dependencies: ["MySharedTypes"]), // MySharedTypes contains a .h file nested inside of a folder named "include", and an empty .m file, specifying that the target should be compiled as an Obj-C target. .target(name: "MySharedTypes") ] ) ```
